Randstad is proud to partner with Queensland Rail (QR) on a major recruitment drive to source engineering professionals. As part of this major recruitment drive, we are looking to identify an experienced Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS for the ETCS Sequence Alliance (Embedded) division.  
  QR has a current project pipeline of over A$15 billion, and this is expected to grow exponentially in the build-up to the 2032 Brisbane Olympic and Paralympic Games.. As a result of this significant investment, the need to secure in-house technical and engineering resources is paramount to support their critical technology rollouts. This includes ensuring that European Train Control Systems (ETCS) telecommunications networks are technically robust and compliant across the network.  
  What You'll Do  
  The Principal Telecommunications Network Engineer - ETCS will provide specialist engineering services and technical leadership to project-based teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that ETCS telecommunications networks are technically robust, commercially optimized, and seamlessly integrated.  
 
  Drive Engineering Excellence  : Monitor and influence ETCS Cross River Rail (CRR) telecommunications data system projects, ensuring peak performance levels are achieved at competitive costs. You will ensure that integration into the QR data network never compromises reliability, availability, or maintainability.  
  Coach & Inspire:   Lead the facilitation of technical training and competency development for telecommunications office and field staff, ensuring a powerful capability uplift and compliance across teams.  
  Innovate & Optimize  : Ensure technical standards and procedures are meticulously documented and applied in accordance with Queensland Rail Quality Assurance and Improvement Principles.  
  Thought Leader  : Provide strategic technical leadership and advice to business groups, technical staff, and external stakeholders, ensuring complex network solutions align perfectly with QR's operational requirements.  
   Uphold Integrity : Champion strict compliance with professional engineering practices, Queensland Rail standards, and all corporate legal and safety obligations.  
 
  What We Are Looking For  
  We are looking for a strong implementor in the network engineering space who brings a deep understanding of data communications, commercial acumen, and high-level stakeholder management skills.  
 
  Qualifications  : A Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical & Electronic)   AND   ideally   current Registered Professional Engineer Queensland (RPEQ) status   or   have the necessary qualifications and experience to attain it. IE: have CEng or Professional Engineer status with Engineers Australia.  
  Network Telecoms Experience:   Extensive knowledge of LAN/WAN data communications, and physical network security applicable to a railway network. You must bring high-level skills in the design, system configuration, construction, auditing, commissioning, integration, and technical support of telecommunications network systems. Candidates would ideally come from a client or contractor background and have strong implementation experience.  
  Analytical & Technical Depth:   Extensive knowledge of telecommunications performance and integration principles, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to keep ETCS CRR projects operationally effective.  
  Commercial Acumen:   A proven track record of delivering business-focused technical and professional network solutions that bring tangible commercial value to the business.  
  Soft Skills & Influence  : High levels of interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation skills.  
 
  Queensland Rail is a progressive organisation that promotes a flexible working environment to allow for a healthy work-life balance. It actively prioritizes the development of its people in a supportive, diverse, and inclusive work culture.  
  QR offers the following benefits:  
 
  Competitive remuneration packages

NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd
Walkaway, Western Australia

Full Time Mobile Plant Operator 
(2 Positions Available)

Salary
AUD $90,000 – $100,000 per annum plus Superannuation, depending on skills and experience.

About us:
NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd is a family-owned agricultural enterprise based in Walkaway, Western Australia, approximately 30 minutes from Geraldton. We operate approximately 4.2 hectares of plastic greenhouses in Walkaway and an additional 2 hectares of plastic greenhouses at the family’s original farm.
We are currently expanding our operations, having purchased 60 acres of land near Walkaway to support future growth and long-term sustainability. NVD Fresh Produce specialises in intensive greenhouse cultivation and is progressively diversifying its crop range, recognising crop rotation as a key strategy to preserve soil health, improve productivity, and maintain consistent supply.

The business is focused on strengthening its production capacity, improving operational systems and water management practices, and establishing a scalable and sustainable structure to support ongoing expansion within Western Australia’s fresh produce market.

The successful applicant will play an important role in supporting the continued growth and success of NVD Fresh Produce's farming operations.

Position Summary
The Mobile Plant Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of mobile plant and agricultural machinery to support NVD Fresh Produce's farming operations. The role involves operating and maintaining plant and equipment for land preparation, cultivation, material handling and general farm activities while ensuring workplace safety, operational efficiency and equipment reliability.

Key Responsibilities
Mobile Plant Operations
•	Operate mobile plant and agricultural machinery safely and efficiently in support of farming operations. 
•	Operate machinery for land preparation, cultivation, material handling and general farm activities. 
•	Load, transport and position goods, materials and equipment as required. 
•	Operate machinery in accordance with workplace procedures and manufacturer guidelines. 

Equipment Maintenance
•	Conduct routine pre-start and post-operation inspections of machinery and equipment. 
•	Report mechanical faults, maintenance requirements and safety issues promptly. 
•	Perform routine cleaning and basic daily maintenance of plant and equipment. 
•	Maintain accurate operational and maintenance records where required. 

Farm Operations Support
•	Assist with general farm operations during planting, harvesting and production periods. 
•	Support the movement of equipment, machinery and materials across farm sites. 
•	Work collaboratively with farm managers and other employees to ensure efficient daily operations. 

Workplace Safety
•	Follow workplace health and safety procedures at all times. 
•	Ensure the safe operation of mobile plant and equipment. 
•	Maintain a professional and safety-focused approach while undertaking all duties.

Qualifications and Skills
Applicants should possess one of the following:
•	A relevant AQF Certificate II qualification (or equivalent) together with at least 1 year's relevant post-qualification employment experience (20+ hours per week); or 
•	At least 2 years' relevant employment experience (10+ hours per week) in lieu of a formal qualification, together with an additional 2 years' relevant full-time employment experience. 

In addition, applicants should demonstrate:
•	Experience operating mobile plant and agricultural machinery in a farming, agricultural or horticultural environment. 
•	Ability to operate mobile plant and agricultural machinery safely and efficiently in accordance with workplace procedures. 
•	Ability to perform routine equipment inspections and basic daily maintenance. 
•	Ability to identify and report mechanical faults and maintenance requirements. 
•	Ability to follow work instructions and communicate effectively with supervisors and team members. 
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team. 
•	A current Australian driver's licence is required. 
•	Commitment to workplace health and safety.


How to apply:

Applications open on 10 July 2026 and close on 9 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Established over eighteen years ago, we are a growing Melbourne-based Software Consultancy with a core focus of delivering business-critical digital products to our clients. Our teams work alongside our customers to dissect their complex problems and convert them into value-driven solutions, combining innovative principles in development, design, analysis and quality automation. We utilise Design Thinking and Agile practices to rapidly create customer and business first software, testing and embracing new technologies and trends along the way.

Our Consultants become trusted advisors to our clients, working alongside other client stakeholders to ensure delivery and technical excellence. As a Fabric Consultant, you will lead by example and work hands-on alongside your teammates on delivery - as well as providing high-level guidance and advice to our customers.

Your key responsibilities as a Senior / Lead Consultant - Native Mobile Developer at Fabric:

-Work under autonomy with a self-driven attitude to own problems and deliver solutions
-Understand the complex business and technical problems, learn quickly, understand tradeoffs and communicate a solution
-Capability to research alternative solutions and propose them within given constraints
-Apply different languages and technologies to your projects while coding side by side with other developers on your team
-Implementing continuous delivery practices to accelerate the delivery of new valuable functionality to its intended users
-Applying test-driven development practices to ensure high quality of the software, and reduce future effort and cost on implementing changes to the product
-Mentoring and coaching less experienced mobile engineers in Fabric family and in our clients’ tech teams, hosting tech meetups and our community events to share your expertise with others
-Advising our clients on the right technical decisions and advocating for the right practices to use
-Being an ambassador for Fabric, promoting our values and the practices we use to make sure we build the software right
-Participate in interviewing and recruitment based on business needs
-Generate thought leadership content relevant to your role to support our marketing department in social media activities and meetups
-Write maintainable, efficient, and scalable code, rigorously adhering to Android coding standards and best practice
-Optimize existing systems for performance, scalability, and reliability, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and inefficiencies
-Take full ownership of assigned projects or components, proactively identifying areas for improvement and leading technical discussions to enhance solutions
-Provide guidance to junior engineers, sharing expertise to foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment
-Participate actively in architectural and design decisions, demonstrating a strong grasp of software design principles and scalability
-Seek out growth opportunities to deepen technical expertise and keep the team informed of emerging best practices

The skills you would need to be a Senior / Lead Consultant - Native Mobile Developer:
??

-7+ years of hands-on experience in Mobile Software Engineering, focusing on scalable architecture and development
-Proficiency in developing for the Android Platform and frameworks relevant to the role
-Experience in the complete Android Development lifecycle, from design, testing, signing, releasing, fixing and beyond
-Understanding of Android’s design principles and interface guidelines
-Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guiding teams.
-Strong problem-solving skills and ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
-Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
-Strong ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Your key benefits of being a part of the Fabric team:

-A variety of business domains to dive into including retail, finance, construction and logistics
-Creating innovative custom products to solve complex problems that existing solutions just can’t
-Collaborating with a team of top notch professionals who are obsessed with value, latest tech and the right way to build a digital product
-Ability to switch projects every 6-12 months to keep you challenged, excited and growing
-Strong support network from the delivery community of practice, leadership and our tech teams to help you address any client challenges you may face
-Very diverse and inclusive environment where people value feedback, connections and collaboration in a workspace
-Great office in CBD with all the amenities (yet you’re welcome to work remotely on most days!), fun team events, lunches and celebrations

Cafe All-Rounder / Kiosk Operator — Founding Team
Permanent part-time | 20–30 hours per week. Burwood Chinatown | Regular evenings and weekends. Structured pathway to Shift Leader

About Swish
Swish Japanese Desserts is a new premium dessert and specialty-drinks kiosk opening at Burwood Chinatown. Our primary product is fresh 'taiyaki'—a sweet Japanese fish-shaped pastry with a crisp exterior and custard filled centre. We will also serve matcha, Japanese-inspired drinks, specialty coffee and soft serve. We are building a small founding team that cares about product accuracy, cleanliness, speed and warm customer service.

The opportunity
You will be trained across the complete kiosk operation, including:
- Cooking fresh taiyaki
- Preparing drinks and desserts to exact recipes
- Customer service and POS operation
- Opening and closing procedures
- Cleaning and sanitising

This role has a structured pathway toward Shift Leader for someone who demonstrates reliability, operating discipline and the ability to support other team members.

You will suit this role if you:
- Consistently arrive on time and ready to work
- Learn quickly and follow recipes precisely
- Maintain high cleanliness standards without repeated reminders
- Work calmly and efficiently during busy periods
- Communicate warmly and clearly with customers
- Accept feedback and apply it
- Take ownership of small problems
- Can commit reliably to evening and weekend shifts
- Want to grow into greater responsibility

Hospitality, dessert, bakery, bubble tea, fast-service or customer-service experience is helpful, but attitude, reliability and ability to learn matter just as much.

*Burwood and late-night availability
Swish’s busiest trading periods will include Thursday–Sunday evenings. Applicants must have a reliable and practical way to travel home from Burwood Chinatown after shifts finishing at approximately 11pm. A short and dependable commute is highly regarded.

*Japanese product and cultural fit
Genuine interest in Japanese food culture and a willingness to learn the names, preparation and story of our products accurately are important. Previous Japanese hospitality experience is helpful but not required. We are looking for respectful curiosity—not prior expertise.

*Language skills
Community-language skills—particularly Japanese, Mandarin or Cantonese—are an advantage for serving Burwood’s diverse customer base, but they are not required.
 
What Swish offers:
- Permanent part-time employment
- Award-compliant pay and applicable penalty rates
- Structured product and operational training
- Food-safety training
- Development toward Shift Leader
- A respectful and inclusive workplace
- The opportunity to help shape a new premium hospitality brand

Please submit your resume with the application and answer:
1. What interests you about joining the founding team of Swish?
2. What evening and weekend availability can you consistently commit to?
3. How will you normally travel home after a late shift in Burwood?
4. Choose one Swish product—taiyaki, matcha, hojicha or azuki—and explain what interests you about learning to prepare and describe it accurately.
5. Tell us about a time you had to follow a precise recipe, process or checklist.
